prompt: Hero is UTG with QsTc on Jd-7c-3h-2s facing turn pressure from BB. One blocker is tempting, but the turn board favors villain's stronger range. Choose the best action.
why_v1: Fold protects chips when the turn board and pressure make one blocker too thin.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Folding fits because the turn board and BB pressure outweigh one blocker.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. One blocker is not enough against the turn board and BB pressure, so continuing would overpay instead of taking the fold.
